title: Blog Tracking
description: Follow clicks, keywords and rankings for your blog posts and category pages from Search Console. Every page is checked weekly, drops raise alerts, and each page gets an SEO and GEO to-do list.
connectHint: Connect Google Search Console to see each post's traffic. You can add posts now; their data appears once Search Console is connected.

empty.title: No posts tracked yet
empty.description: Blog posts that get impressions in Search Console are added automatically by the weekly check. You can also add them by hand now.
empty.categoryDescription: Category pages that get impressions in Search Console are added automatically by the weekly check. You can also add them by hand now.

row.removeConfirm: Stop tracking this page? It won't be added back automatically.
row.aiTitle: {{sessions}} visits from AI, cited {{citations}} times in AI answers

queries.title: Keywords bringing clicks and impressions (vs previous period)
queries.empty: No search queries for this post in this period.
queries.volumeHint: Estimated monthly Google searches. Unknown ones show as –.

add.title: Add blog posts
add.urlsHint: One post per line. Optionally add the target keyword after a comma: https://site.com/blogs/news/post, tote bags
add.suggestionsTitle: Blog pages found in Search Console
add.suggestionsHint: Pages that look like blog posts and already get impressions.
add.nothingToAdd: Enter at least one URL or pick a suggested page.
add.categoryUrlsHint: One category URL per line. Optionally add the target keyword after a comma: https://site.com/collections/tote-bags, tote bags

edit.title: Edit post
edit.targetKeywordPlaceholder: The keyword this post should rank for
edit.publishedAtHint: Posts published in the last 30 days are marked as new.

check.done: Check finished, data is up to date.
check.partial: Loading past weeks. The rest finishes on the next check, or press it again.
check.lastWeek: Last weekly check: week of {{week}}. Pages are checked automatically every week.
check.never: No weekly check yet. If Search Console is connected the first one runs tonight, or press "Check now".

insights.noHistory: Weekly data appears after the first check.
insights.noOpportunities: No standout keyword opportunity right now.
insights.noLinks: No good internal link suggestions for this page.
insights.linkIn: Link to this page from these posts:
insights.unreachable: The page couldn't be opened, so page checks were skipped.

opportunity.addToHeadings: "{{query}}" ranks {{position}} with {{impressions}} impressions but isn't in the title or subheadings. Add it to the title or an H2.
opportunity.expand: "{{query}}" ranks {{position}} ({{impressions}} impressions). Expand the section on it to reach the top 3.
opportunity.lowCtr: "{{query}}" ranks {{position}} but gets few clicks. Rewrite the title and meta description to earn the click.
opportunity.competing: Another page on your site competes for "{{query}}": {{url}}. Pick the one to rank, link to it from the other, or separate their topics.

checks.title_length: The title is {{value}} characters. Keep it between 30 and 65.
checks.meta_description: The meta description is {{value}} characters. Write a 70–160 character description that earns the click.
checks.single_h1: The page has {{value}} H1 headings. It should have exactly one.
checks.article_schema: No Article/BlogPosting schema. Add it so Google and AI assistants understand the post.
checks.category_schema: No CollectionPage, ItemList or BreadcrumbList schema. Add it to the category page.
checks.image_alt: {{value}} images have no alt text. Add short alt text describing each image.
checks.word_count: The page has {{value}} words, thin for the topic. Expand the content.
checks.canonical: The canonical tag is missing or points to another URL.
checks.indexed: Google doesn't seem to have indexed this page. Request indexing in Search Console.
checks.faq: No FAQ section. Add one to raise the chance of being quoted in AI answers.
checks.question_headings: {{value}} subheadings are phrased as questions. Use the questions people ask as H2/H3s.
checks.lists_tables: No lists or tables in the content. Give steps and comparisons as lists or tables; AI assistants quote them easily.
checks.author: No author shown. Name the author; it's a trust signal.
checks.dates: No publish or update date found. Show it on the page and in schema.
checks.fresh: The content hasn't been updated in {{value}} days. Refresh it and update the modified date.
checks.citations: {{value}} links to outside sources. Cite 2–3 trusted sources; AI assistants favor sourced content.

geo.aiSessions: {{sessions}} visits from AI assistants this period: {{sources}}.
geo.noAiSessions: No visits from AI assistants this period (needs Google Analytics connected).
geo.citations: Cited {{count}} times in AI Visibility runs: {{engines}}.
geo.noCitations: Not cited as a source in AI Visibility runs yet.

advice.title: AI advice
advice.hintBlog: Get title, meta description, keyword, section, link and FAQ suggestions for this post. It's generated once when you press the button and saved.
advice.hintCategory: Get title, meta description, category copy, keyword and link suggestions for this category. It's generated once when you press the button and saved.

alerts.emptyDescription: Pages whose clicks drop, rankings slip or keywords are lost in the weekly check show up here.
alerts.hint: The last 4 weeks are compared with the 4 weeks before.

messages.no_impressions: No Google impressions in the last 4 weeks.
messages.rising: Clicks {{previous}} → {{current}}. Look for follow-up content ideas.

rewrite.hint: Copies the current content, keyword data and every suggestion on this page as one prompt. Paste it into Claude to update the page. Free.
rewrite.title: Rewrite prompt for Claude
rewrite.description: The prompt was copied to your clipboard. If not, use the button below, then paste it into Claude.
rewrite.copied: Prompt copied, paste it into Claude

card.title: Blog and category tracking
card.empty: No pages tracked yet. Press "Check now" in Blog Tracking.
card.noPriority: No page needs an urgent update right now.
